description:
You are an energy auditor optimizing the Domestic Hot Water (DHW) system for the 4StoreyBuilding project. The current model uses standard design values, but a retrofit is planned using a low-flow strategy and a high-efficiency ECM pump.

Update the eQUEST model with the following changes:
1. Navigate to the Water-Side HVAC module.
2. Locate the Domestic Hot Water Loop (typically named 'DHW Loop').
3. Change the Loop Design Temperature (LOOP-DESIGN-T) to 120°F.
4. Locate the Circulation Pump attached to this loop.
5. Change the Pump Head to 20 ft.
6. Change the Pump Mechanical Efficiency to 0.75.

After making these changes, run the full annual DOE-2.2 simulation to validate the results and save the project.
